summary:
Both round-1 findings are fixed. F1: the relaxed CSP now goes only to the newsletter pages and to `/` for visitors with no server-side session. `*.google.com` is replaced by `*.analytics.google.com`, and a new durable test confirms that signed-in `/`, `/login` and `/settings` keep the strict policy and an empty measurement ID. F2: the Playwright config uses the bundled Chromium, and `@playwright/test@1.62.1` is now declared. All test runs pass. The one line still reported uncovered, `marketingAnalytics.ts:114` (the declaration of `trackWaitlistSubmission`), runs in the durable unit tests, whose body lines are covered. Its coverage-exempt comment sits one line below the declaration, and I accept its reason.

Not approved: 1 changed line(s) are uncovered.
